judged_text: update passes EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first to save_host with no nil guard, so a nonexistent id makes save_host call nil.host= and raise NoMethodError, returning a 500. An admin who saves a host another admin just deleted (stale tab), or any PUT to a dead id, receives a raw 500 exception instead of the 404 the REST resource contract implies.

adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update`, the code does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally calls `save_host(host)`. `save_host` immediately dereferences `host` (`host.host = ...`, `host.category_id = ...`), so if the record isn’t found (e.g., stale tab / deleted by another admin / arbitrary PUT to missing id), it will raise `NoMethodError` and return a 500 instead of a not-found response.
